# er605_lan (Resource)

Network > LAN > Network list (one row per LAN; DHCP options of a LAN are in er605_dhcp_server for the default one). Editing the IP of the LAN you are connected through drops your connection. Creating extra LANs is untested; the default LAN is never deleted, only forgotten.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipaddr` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `netmask` (String)
- `vlanid` (String)

### Optional

- `mode` (String) normal or bridge

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
